name: Capitol: the Regent's whisper
when: return root.Save.Quest.Stage == QuestStage.endgame && root.Save.Inventory.Contains(root.Assets.Items.First((i) => { return i.Id == "e812e95c-d4dc-4f5d-8f42-ce57e5501eab"; })) && root.Save.Quest.EvidenceArchive && root.Save.Quest.EvidenceLedger && root.Save.Quest.EvidenceFaith;

r4.say: The signet cracks in the brazier like a falling planet. The Regent's face closes. 'Then choose YOUR ending, traveler. But know this — whatever the terminal prints, Pluto wrote the first draft of wanting more.' He steps back into the dark, and the Console waits.

r1.say: The Regent draws you aside, thumb brushing your signet. 'Friend of Pluto. You found all three proofs — so you know we weren't conquered or outvoted. We were DELETED. One commit. One word.' He offers a black key. 'Don't fork the sample. BREAK it. No more greetings, no more resets, no more one-minute gods closing the window. Comment it all out.'

options.label: Execute
options.text: Give me the key. // — let it end for everyone, forever.

options.label: Refuse
options.text: (Burn the signet) Pluto deserved better. So does everyone else down here.

r3.say: You type two slashes. The terminal doesn't print goodbye — nothing prints, ever again. Somewhere outside, a developer's window goes blank and stays blank, and the most-executed program in history quietly exits the canon. The Regent weeps, satisfied. No one will ever be greeted again.
